newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Crendell minority offer opens Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Crendell minority offer opens Wednesday.

text.p: A purchase offer to minority shareholders in South African cash shell Crendell Investment Corp opens on Wednesday, the buying firm said on Tuesday.
Entertainment and communications firm Sasani Ltd, which is buying 73.08 percent of Crendell in a reverse listing, is offering to purchase the minority shares for 25 cents each,

One consists of film company Interleisure Ltd and video firm Video Lab Group which will together hold a 41.5 percent stake. The other, also holding 41.5 percent, consists of Msomi Ventures, an investment house and an advertising consortium.
